sintjan.name: St. John's Cathedral
sintjan.slogan: Brabant's Gothic crown, with an angel on the phone.
sintjan.line: During the 1998–2010 restoration, sculptor Ton Mooy added a new angel to the roof — holding a mobile phone.

jbactoren.name: Jheronimus Bosch Art Center
jbactoren.slogan: Bosch's hometown, and a glass lift into his nightmares.
jbactoren.line: A world of dreams and nightmares in which forms seem to flicker and change before our eyes.
jbactoren.by: Walter Gibson, art historian, on Hieronymus Bosch

loevestein.name: Loevestein Castle
loevestein.slogan: The prison with a very good book chest.
loevestein.line: In 1621 Hugo Grotius escaped this castle hidden in a chest of books, with his wife's help.

heusdenmolens.name: Heusden Fortress Town
heusdenmolens.slogan: Windmills turning on ramparts rebuilt from an old map.
heusdenmolens.line: Heusden's walls were rebuilt from 1968 after Blaeu's 1649 map, and won a European restoration prize in 1980.

uilenburg.name: Binnendieze
uilenburg.slogan: A hidden river that runs right underneath the houses of the old town.
uilenburg.line: Of the old network of city waterways, the Binnendieze still flows for about 3.5 km, much of it under buildings and streets.
